execution: Verified archived trade sequences or verified 1m bars where cached, otherwise 15m OHLC. Both high/low order conventions are tested. Historical mark prices and fixed-interval polling are unavailable for this replay. Equity marked at the 15m close.
capital_assumptions: 1000 USDT initially split 500/500, max 5x per sleeve, monthly 50/50 marked rebalance, 0.05% per fill, 0.02% adverse exit slippage; no funding or liquidation model.
data: Existing continuous BTC and ETH USDT perpetual series. Binance early, Bybit after each venue switch.

exit_policies.cap5: 2% initial stop and 1% profit locks through rung 5.
exit_policies.uncapped: Keep stepping by 1% as favorable movement increases.
exit_policies.trail_from_8pct: Keep the fifth rung until 8% favorable movement, then resume the ladder. This is a sensitivity case past the range of the four live fills.

regimes: Closed 1h signed efficiency ratios, 24h threshold 0.20 and 120h threshold 0.10. Report both directions in each state. The filter only blocks trades against a confirmed up or down state.
